title: Latency Lightbox: interactive route/model percentile explorer with stream-mode toggle
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Goal: Build an interactive dashboard (Latency Lightbox) that lets SREs, runtime engineers, and PMs quickly compare p50/p95/p99 latency across model variants and API routes with a first-class streaming vs non-streaming (io_mode) toggle. The view should surface distribution heatmaps, tail traces links, cohort comparisons, and make it easy to pivot by request shape, sequence length, and client region.

Scope:
- Add an io_mode tag at request ingress (gateway/edge) and ensure it propagates through trace headers and metrics pipeline.
- Expand latency metric label set to include: model_name, route_name, serve_path, io_mode (streaming|sync), request_shape_bucket, region.
- Tracing hooks: attach serve_path and io_mode to spans at the routing layer, add 1:1 link from percentile bucket to representative trace id.
- Metrics/log pipeline: enrich ClickHouse/River tables with io_mode and model tags, update materialized views for percentiles and histograms.
- Dashboard panels: percentile skyline (p50/p95/p99), distribution heatmap (serve_path x percentile), streaming vs sync diff panel, cohort drift over time, tail trace explorer with example request payloads redacted.

Acceptance criteria:
1) io_mode is present on 99% of ingested requests within 12h of rollout in staging.
2) New percentile queries return consistent p50/p95/p99 when compared to raw traces within +/-5% for representative workloads.
3) Dashboard supports toggling between streaming/sync and shows linked traces for top p99 offenders.
4) Runbook updated with playbook for investigating latency spikes using the Lightbox.

Out of scope for this ticket: automated remediation and SLA adjustments (to be separate follow-ups).
implementation_notes:
Instrumentation: modify edge proxy middleware to add header X-RW-IO-MODE (values 'streaming'|'sync') and set serve_path metadata at route resolution. Tracing: update trace-enricher lambda to add tags 'rw.model', 'rw.serve_path', 'rw.io_mode'. Metrics: ClickHouse ingestion to add io_mode column and backfill last 7 days using traces->metrics join job.

Queries (examples):
- Percentiles (ClickHouse): quantiles(0.5,0.95,0.99)(latency_ms) BY model_name, route_name, io_mode, toDate(event_ts)
- Heatmap: histogramBucket(latency_ms, [0,50,100,200,500,1000,2000]) by serve_path and io_mode

Dashboards: Use Lightbox as a new folder under Observability -> Latency Tools. Panels will include exportable JSON, links to trace search, and an annotation lane for deploys/rollouts.
